levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: searches in a checkerboard, follows the hull

help.goal: Sink all five of the other player's ships before they sink yours.
steps: Your fleet starts placed for you — tap ⚓ Ready to sail with it.
To rearrange: drag a ship on the board, or tap a ship and then tap the square its bow should sit on.
↻ Rotate (or tapping the selected ship again) turns it; 🔀 Shuffle re-rolls the whole fleet.
Green means the ship fits there, red means it does not.
On your turn tap any square in 🎯 Target to fire there.
💥 is a hit, • is a miss, 🚢 is a sunk ship. Your own sea rides along as the minimap — tap it to swap the two boards.
notes: Once you tap ⚓ Ready your fleet is locked in for the game.
A hit does not earn you another shot. Turns alternate after every single shot.
House rule: ships are allowed to touch, so there is no gap between hulls.
